title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/24 (1 DVD FLAC)
source: (FOB/13th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Sony FeCr90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording despite mixed feelings about the performance
ai_review.review: Reviewers compliment the audio quality, calling it a great recording that captures the band sounding right, though one reviewer notes the performance itself wasn’t stellar. A second comment laments taping legalities rather than the music. Overall the sound is praised while the show details remain vague.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews with opposing star ratings; recording quality is praised but no concrete information on the musical performance, leading to an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer describes the tape as a 'great recording' that makes the band sound right; no details on whether it is soundboard, audience, or matrix.
